spans.s: The eleventh vowel of the alphabet, corresponding to the letter E as pronounced in most languages except the English, and having the sound of A in amiable.

ind.
An interjection of,
1 Remembering, (ha.)
2 Censure or contempt.
3 Compassion, (ah!)
4 Addressing, (eh! hey.)
5 Calling, (hey, ho.)
(-एः)
A name of VIṢṆU.
